notes.title: Update v0.3.1.c
notes.notes:
The February update (version 0.3.1.c_EA) is now available on Steam!

Check out the new features and improvements:
[list]
[*]Extraction Beam: This brand-new train module lets you mine and scrap wrecked trains for valuable materials. It also allows you to gather resources from a distance, boosting your efficiency.
[*]New Dome Building: A mysterious new building has been added to the dome. Explore it to find additional resources and hidden secrets!
[*]Balance Adjustments: We've made subtle tweaks to the game's balance to make resource gathering easier and reduce consumption in certain situations.
[*]Expanded Building Options: You can now place hatches and fences on the third floor of your train, giving you more creative freedom.
[*]Localization Support: We've laid the foundation for future support of multiple languages.
[*]Enhanced Indoor Lighting: Enjoy improved indoor lighting that adds to the game's atmosphere.
[*]Bug Fixes and Tweaks: This update also includes a variety of bug fixes and minor tweaks to improve your overall gameplay experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.3.0.m
notes.notes:
Heat Death: Survival Train v0.3.0.m_EA is now live!

[b]What's New:[/b]

-   [b]Respawning:[/b] We've changed the respawn system so you'll always respawn on the train, whether you have a body scanner or not.
-   [b]Module Deterioration:[/b] Modules will no longer deteriorate on their own. However, they will take damage during storms. You can protect them by enclosing them with walls and a roof.
-   [b]Multi-Engine:[/b] The effect of the second engine on train speed has been increased.
-   [b]Resources:[/b] We've increased the availability of resources, and blueprint costs for certain modules have been further decreased.
-   [b]Save Slots:[/b] We've added two more save slots, bringing the total to five, to help you better organize your playthroughs.
-   [b]Tweaks and More:[/b] Various tweaks and bug fixes to enhance your overall experience.

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Update v0.3.0.k_EA is now live!
notes.notes:
Heat Death v0.3.0.k_EA is now live! This update focuses on improving the game balance based on community feedback. 

[b]What's New and Improved:[/b]

- [b]Challenge Adjustments:[/b] We’ve reduced enemy counts in both easy and normal difficulty levels to smooth out your gameplay experience.

- [b]Power Boost:[/b] Power cells now add 600 power capacity to your train (previously 500).

- [b]Enhanced Energy:[/b] Fission fuel generators now generate more power—+300 in easy mode and +240 in normal mode (up from +180).

- [b]Stronger Trains:[/b] Build 33% heavier trains with the same acceleration power.

- [b]Slower Deterioration:[/b] Modules now deteriorate slower in easy mode.

- [b]Warmer Interiors:[/b] Staying inside your train before constructing a heater is now 15% warmer.

- [b]Reduced Enemy Damage:[/b] Enemies deal less damage in both easy and normal modes, giving you a fighting chance.

- [b]Tougher Scrappers:[/b] Scrappers are now twice as durable in normal mode and completely indestructible in easy mode (unless you blast them directly!).

- [b]Solar Panel:[/b] The Solar panel produces 60 power under the starlight, and it won't deteriorate anymore. 

- [b]Blueprint balance:[/b] Blueprint requirement for certain modules and crafting recipes has been reduced.

- [b]Resources:[/b] We've added more materials to the stations. Also, it's more likely to find resources inside the lockers and enemies.

- [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We’ve fixed a few bugs affecting the battery charger and SeedEx placement.

- [b]Tweaks and More:[/b] Various tweaks and bug fixes to enhance your overall experience.

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Major public demo update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781887/6e1ac10d70cc98a1340b77962ced9bce9dbed350.jpg[/img]We’re excited to announce that Heat Death v0.2.5.m_demo is live on the Steam public branch. 

[b]Here is what's new:[/b]
- [b]Airborne Scout Drones (New Enemy Type):[/b] The old scout drones have been replaced with new airborne drones that are faster and more challenging to overcome.
- [b]Rapid Burst (New Train Weapon):[/b] The Rapid Burst weapon uses train power instead of ammo. This weapon is designed to defend the train against the new drones.
- [b]Heat as a Resource:[/b] This community-suggested system now physically propagates heat on the train, meaning you must consider structural module insulation (e.g., walls are better insulators than windows). Certain modules (like engines) will produce small amounts of heat, but if you keep the doors open during a storm, all of it will dissipate.
- [b]Physical Train:[/b] Train physics is now more realistic. Each module has mass, and as you build them, the train becomes heavier, reducing its acceleration. Storms will also change the train's air drag, reducing its top speed during storms.
- [b]Fall Damage:[/b] You'll now take fall damage. Please let us know how this affects your play style.
- [b]Blueprint as a Resource:[/b] By popular demand, you can now unlock the modules you want instead of relying on random unlocks! Blueprints are now a collectible resource in your inventory.
- [b]New Structure Unlocking System:[/b] Structural modules are no longer available from the start. You’ll need to reach train stations to unlock them.
- [b]Fission Reactor (New Module):[/b] This powerful module generates energy using fuel. However, it’s radioactive while in operation and produces highly radioactive waste that must be stored or disposed of safely!
- [b]Module Deterioration:[/b] Modules like the Engine, Dynamo, and Fission Reactor will now wear down over time, adding a new challenge to maintaining your train.
- [b]Difficulty Levels and Game Balance:[/b] We’ve introduced new difficulty levels and rebalanced the game accordingly. You can adjust the difficulty level at any time during your adventure.
- [b]Compass:[/b] The HUD now has a new compass UI that shows enemies while you're in battle.
- [b]Infinite Player Inventory:[/b] Your inventory is now infinite! However, if you carry items beyond the limit, you won't be able to run or jump.
- [b]Other Changes and Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]Please note that: Due to the extensive changes, we had to reset the save files in this version, but you'll be able to load save files from this version in the first Early access release.[/b]

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

We're thrilled to announce that Heat Death: Survival Train Demo [b]v0.1.12.j[/b] is now rolling out on the public branch of Steam! This update focuses on train customization, bringing new ways to customize your train by adding more modules, stickers, color changes, etc.

[b]Steam Deck and Linux users:[/b] You can use Proton 7.0-6 to avoid the repeated installation of prerequisites every time you start the game, or you can stay on Proton Experimental and either install or uninstall the recommended prerequisites every time the message pops out to bypass it.
